extraction.name: Cleaned YODAS
extraction.description: A curated speech dataset containing 166,000 hours of speech across 75 languages, created by cleaning the large-scale web-crawled YODAS dataset.
extraction.creator: Yifan Peng, Muhammad Shakeel, Yui Sudo, William Chen, Jinchuan Tian, Chyi-Jiunn Lin, Shinji Watanabe
extraction.inLanguage: en, es, it, ja, ko, pt, ca, de, fr, id, zh, ru, th, vi, nl, be, tr, bn, hi, gl, uk
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The authors integrated YODAS, an existing web-crawled dataset, and developed a scalable data-cleaning pipeline using public toolkits (such as CTC-score-based filtering) to fix incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data is YODAS, a large-scale web-crawled dataset with a Creative Commons license, characterized by its "wild nature" including incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The raw web-crawled data suffers from quality issues, specifically incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset is used for training speech foundation models (specifically speech-to-text models).
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset was cleaned using a CTC-score-based filtering pipeline to remove incorrect language labels and audio-text misalignments, specifically using a threshold of θCTC = 0.10.
